metadata.name: lockup
metadata.description: LOCKUP - sealed-bid storage units on Solana + MagicBlock

instructions.name: add_item
docs: Add one item type to the catalog and open its warehouse token account.

instructions.name: buy_item
docs: Buy `qty` items from a listing. The buyer pays the seller directly; the items leave the
stall in the same instruction. `max_price` guards against a relist at a higher price.

instructions.name: cancel_listing
docs: Take unsold items back and close the listing.

instructions.name: claim_lot
docs: Move one lot of the contents from the warehouse to the winner. Anyone can run it.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Where the yard's share of the winning bid is paid. Must belong to the yard's operator.

accounts.name: consignment
docs: A player's waiting items of this kind. Required whenever the pool has any.

accounts.name: seller_payout
docs: The consigning player's account for the bid currency. Its owner is checked against the consignment.

instructions.name: close_unit
docs: Read every sealed bid at once, pick the winner, and write bids, contents and salt into
the unit so they travel to Solana with the commit.
`remaining_accounts` = the manifest, then every bid. Each is checked to be the PDA
this program derives, so nobody can pass a forged bid or a different manifest.

instructions.name: commit_and_settle
docs: `commit_unit`, plus a Magic Action per bidder: as soon as the unit is back on Solana,
MagicBlock runs `settle_on_commit` for each of them, so refunds and the winner's change
arrive without anyone sending a settlement transaction. Remaining accounts are the
bidders' token accounts in line order. The actions are not atomic with the commit; if one
fails, `settle_bidder` still works.

instructions.name: commit_unit
docs: Commit the closed unit to Solana and release it from the rollup.
Must not modify the unit: `commit_and_undelegate` hands the account to the Magic
program inside this instruction, so any write (including Anchor's exit write on a
typed `mut` account) is rejected. Hence `UncheckedAccount` and hand validation.

instructions.name: consign
docs: Hand items you hold to the yard to be sold inside units. They go into the warehouse that
units are stocked from; the random draw decides which unit they come out of. When they
do, `claim_lot` pays you their share of the winning bid.

accounts.name: consignment
docs: One per seller per item. Consigning again adds to it.

instructions.name: create_unit
docs: Open a unit for people to line up. `salt_commit` is sha256 of a salt the operator keeps until close.

instructions.name: deal_hint
docs: Deal one bidder their private clue: a true statement about the unit that is not on the
door, taken from the sealed manifest. Bidders in even and odd places get different ones.
Send `seal_hint` in the same transaction so only that bidder can read it.

instructions.name: delegate_unit
docs: Hand the unit to the private rollup's validator for the bidding phase.

instructions.name: draw_callback
docs: Called by the VRF program only. Stores the randomness, once, and starts the bidding clock.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: init_pool
docs: Open the shelf for one item type: its consignment count and price record. Anyone can pay for it.

instructions.name: init_unit_permission
docs: The unit itself is public on the rollup: clock, clues and who is in line.

instructions.name: init_yard
docs: Create a yard, its deposit vault, and take over the test-dollar mint for the faucet.

accounts.name: bid_mint
docs: The bid currency. Any SPL mint works (the live yard uses Circle's devnet USDC). The
`faucet` instruction only works for a mint whose authority is the yard PDA.

instructions.name: join_unit
docs: Get in line: escrow a deposit on Solana. The deposit is public and caps your bid.

instructions.name: list_item
docs: Put items you hold up for sale at a fixed price each. They move into a stall owned by
the yard and stay there until bought or taken back.

accounts.name: listing
docs: One listing per seller per item. Cancel it to change the price.

instructions.name: lock_in
docs: Lock in: this bidder is done. When everyone in line has locked in, the door can open
without waiting for the clock.

instructions.name: place_bid
docs: Place a bid. Send `seal_bid` in the same transaction.

instructions.name: raise_bid
docs: Raise a sealed bid. The new amount stays as private as the first one; what the table
sees is only that this bidder raised, and when. A raise of one cent looks exactly like a
raise of a dollar, so a raise can be a bluff.

instructions.name: reclaim_stalled
docs: Escape hatch: take the whole deposit back from a unit that has stalled.
While the line is still open, an hour after joining: the bidder also leaves the line, so
the deposit they took back can no longer back a bid. Once the unit is locked, an hour
after its clock ran out with no result on Solana; by then bidding is over. Works while the
unit is still held by the rollup.

accounts.name: unit
docs: bidder record by address; the record names its yard.

instructions.name: request_draw
docs: Ask MagicBlock VRF again for a locked unit whose draw has not arrived. `start_unit` makes
the first request; this exists only so a lost request cannot strand a unit.

instructions.name: seal_bid
docs: Make a bid private: only its bidder can read it. Not even the operator.

instructions.name: seal_hint
docs: Make a private clue private: only its bidder can read it. Not even the operator.

instructions.name: seal_manifest
docs: Make the manifest private: only the operator, who already knows the salt, can read it.

instructions.name: settle_bidder
docs: Pay one bidder what they are owed. Anyone can run it: the numbers come from the unit.
The winner gets their deposit minus the winning bid. Everyone else gets it all back.
The winning bid itself waits in the vault for `claim_lot`.

instructions.name: settle_on_commit
docs: The same payout as `settle_bidder`, run by MagicBlock as a Magic Action the moment the
unit is back on Solana. Scheduled by `commit_and_settle`, one per bidder. Only the action
path can call it: it requires the fee escrow that only MagicBlock's delegation program
can sign for.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: this instruction to the Magic Action path.

instructions.name: start_unit
docs: Lock the line and ask MagicBlock VRF for the unit's randomness. From here nobody can
join or leave, and only now is the draw requested.

instructions.name: stock_unit
docs: Derive the contents from randomness + salt, hide them in a manifest, post three clues.
Send `seal_manifest` in the same transaction.

instructions.name: withdraw_consignment
docs: Take back consigned items that have not been sold yet.

types.name: Bid
docs: A sealed bid. Exists only on the private rollup; only the bidder can read it.

types.name: Bidder
docs: One wallet's place in line for one unit. Lives on Solana and holds the escrow record.

types.name: Consignment
docs: Items one wallet has handed to the yard to be sold inside units. When one of them comes out
of a unit, its share of the winning bid is paid to the seller by the program.

fields.name: qty
docs: Still waiting to be sold. Can be taken back at any time.

types.name: Hint
docs: One bidder's private clue. Exists only on the private rollup; only that bidder can read it.

fields.name: value
docs: Appraised value in cents of the bid currency.

types.name: ItemFacts
docs: The catalog facts the rollup needs to stock a unit. Copied into the unit at creation.

types.name: Listing
docs: One wallet's offer to sell one kind of item it holds. The items wait in a stall owned by
the yard until someone buys them or the seller takes them back.

fields.name: price
docs: Price of one item, in the bid currency's smallest unit.

types.name: Manifest
docs: A unit's contents. Exists only on the private rollup until the unit closes.

fields.name: spare
docs: Two true clues that are not on the door. `deal_hint` gives each bidder one of them.

types.name: Pool
docs: One item type's shelf in the yard: how many consigned items are waiting in the warehouse, and
the price record anyone can read. Auction prices are each lot's share of a winning bid;
market prices are fixed-price resales.

fields.name: consigned
docs: Player-owned items waiting in the warehouse. They are sold before the yard's own stock.

fields.name: auction_paid
docs: Bid currency paid for those items, in its smallest unit.

fields.name: auction_last
docs: Price of one item in the most recent unit it came out of.

fields.name: deposit
docs: Escrowed on Solana. Public. Caps the bid.

fields.name: bid
docs: Zero until the unit is closed. While bids are sealed the amount exists only in the
bidder's private `Bid` account.

types.name: Tell
docs: What everyone at the table can see of a bidder while bids are sealed. Never an amount.

fields.name: raises
docs: How many times the bidder has raised their sealed bid.

fields.name: locked
docs: Locked in: this bidder is done, and cannot raise again.

fields.name: hinted
docs: This bidder has been dealt their private clue.

fields.name: last_at
docs: Seconds after the bidding clock started at which they last acted.

fields.name: salt_commit
docs: sha256(salt). The salt stays with the operator until the unit closes.

fields.name: randomness
docs: From MagicBlock VRF. Public, and useless without the salt.

fields.name: salt
docs: Published at close so anyone can recompute the contents from randomness + salt.

fields.name: claimed_mask
docs: Bit i set = lot i has been paid out to the winner.

fields.name: tells
docs: One per slot, in line order: the public side of each bidder's sealed play. Empty on
units from before raising existed, and until the first move.
